title: Truncated universal nearby-cycle comparison and alteration geometry
statement:
For a finite commutative ring $\Lambda$, a scheme morphism $f:X\to S$, and $K\in D^b(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$, use the vanishing topos and ordinary comparison $\beta$ of [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles]. For $r\in\mathbf Z$, write $P_r(f,K)$ if for every $T\to S$ and every $T'\to T$ the cone of the ordinary comparison for $(f_T,K_T)$ and $T'\to T$ has $H^i=0$ for all $i\le r$. Thus the quantifier includes comparisons after an arbitrary preliminary base change, and does not merely truncate the comparison over $S$.

A modification of a reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] Noetherian scheme $S$ (quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]) is a proper morphism $S'\to S$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] which is an isomorphism over a dense open subscheme $U\subset S$ [def-weil-open-immersion], i.e. $S'\times_SU\to U$ is an isomorphism [def-pc-fibre-product], and for which the inverse image of $U$ is dense in $S'$. An alteration is a proper surjective morphism, finite over a dense open of the target, all of whose irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components] dominate irreducible components of the target. A semistable tower datum for this proof consists of an identity, or a finite tower of proper flat morphisms [def-weil-flat-morphism] whose geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] are connected reduced curves (schemes of pure dimension one [def-weil-pure-dimension]) with only ordinary double points, together with, for each factor, a chosen closed subscheme finite over its base [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] whose complement is smooth over that base [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. At a geometric ordinary double point the completion of the local ring of the fibre at its maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] is $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$. An almost plurinodal datum here means a finite disjoint union of these semistable towers and a proper morphism with nowhere dense image. This is the proper tower data underlying the projective plurinodal morphisms supplied by the alteration theorem. Excellence of a scheme means excellence of every affine coordinate ring [def-exc-excellent-ring].

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q41-615a3391c (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the whole item, its 7 stmt_deps, all 10 nodes that cite it, the unit sk-i-curve-zero and the blueprint ancestor. The delivery adds no new nodes; the item is a definition with no proof steps. Source: the Orgogozo IMRN 2006 PDF is not in literature/ and network access is blocked, so I could not read §§1, 3.1, 3.3 at the cited place (already WANTED, as in the Q28 review). I checked the geometric terms against the archived Illusie–Laszlo–Orgogozo (Travaux de Gabber) instead. Its alteration (proper, surjective, generically finite, maximally dominating; p.148) and nodal curve (proper flat, connected 1-dimensional geometric fibres, only ordinary quadratic points; IX p.131) match the item. Its R-Psi and base-change map (§4, (4.d)/(4.e)) agree with the comparison beta of def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles. P_r: H^i(cone)=0 for i<=r means iso on H^i for i<=r and injective on H^{r+1}. P_r for all r is equivalent to Psi-good, by composing beta across T'->T->S. The double quantifier is genuinely needed: the octahedral axiom loses one degree, so truncation over S alone would not suffice. Checked against the citers: hyperdescent spectral-sequence bookkeeping, including the r=-1 case with K in D^{>=0}; closed image; finite descent; proper exchange; spread-out. Edge cases: identity modification and identity tower, Lambda=0, r<<0. No hidden existence claim and no duplicate definition in the DAG. Base change is the Cartesian square over T'->T with constant finite Lambda on small étale topoi; no target node involved. No SGA, no tool_uses. FIX (B3, missing citations, one fault): reduced, Noetherian, isomorphism over U, irreducible components, geometric fibres, curve (pure dimension 1) and completed local ring had no citation. Added pqf-def-locnoeth, def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion, def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-irreducible-components, def-weil-geometric-fibre, def-weil-pure-dimension and def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, inline and in stmt_deps. Also made 'complement is smooth' read 'smooth over that base'. None of the 8 is merged and none cites the item, so no cycle; meaning unchanged.
